scope: Theorem 1.1 (Filtered products) of the manuscript “Filtered products and boundary-preserving compression in complex cobordism” (preprints/Filtered-products-and-boundary-preserving-compression-in-complex-cobordism-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 302 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c47745026b3a083c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G ⊂ E be a finite pointed CW pair, let d ≥ 0 be an integer, and let v : E → Sd be a based map. Suppose that the composite Σ∞ G −→ Σ∞ E Σ∞v − − − → Σd S −→ Σd MU is nullhomotopic. For ℓ ≥ 1, let Uℓ ⊂ E∧ℓ be the union of the subcomplexes in which at least ⌈ℓ/2⌉ factors are required to belong to G. Then, for every sufficiently large ℓ, the restriction v∧ℓ |Uℓ : Uℓ −→ Sdℓ is stably nullhomotopic.
